g.text: genes; not a direct measure of EMT
Every project score is the mean training-fold-standardised mRNA of a fixed gene set in bulk tumour tissue. It summarises expression. It does not
measure pathway activation, protein activity, mutation status or the cell type the mRNA came from.
Conceptual schematic: lanes are parallel axes, not a causal sequence. Mechanisms are textbook background. Context: verified references R1–R8
(docs/BIOLOGICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_CITATION_AUDIT.md). Gene counts: MSigDB Hallmark v2026.2.Hs, config/pathways/m2_panel_4set.json.
